incident-bot: PagerDuty: P2 - multiple runtime containers crashlooping on prod-cluster-3 (sev: elevated)
devon (oncall): looking now. seeing repeated segfaults in runtime pod set 'inference-engine-rt' in us-west-2c.
sasha (runtime): can you paste the last few lines of the pod log? suspect fused-kernel/TensorRT path.
devon (oncall): logs: ```
2026-01-12T03:14:22Z ERROR runtime: panic: signal: segmentation fault (core dumped)
#0 0x7f2a1f3b in fused_attention_kernel::dispatch(...) at fused_attention_kernel.cu:428
#1 0x7f2a1a9c in runtime::forward(...) at engine.cc:1124
```
jia (eng-sre): node is flapping, kubelet restarted 3x in 5m. multiple pods on same node OOM + segfault traces. might be hardware GPU reset.
marie (support): i'm getting customer reports — AcmePay requests failing with 500/connection-reset. ticket queue rising. priority escalate.
devon (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon node, 2) drain workload to other healthy nodes, 3) scale down inference replicas to reduce pressure, 4) switch runtime to fallback kernel builds w/ env override. doing steps 1-2 now.
ops-bot: Command executed: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-23-17.us-west-2.compute.internal` (ok)
devon (oncall): drain started: `kubectl drain ip-10-0-23-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` — waiting for pods to reschedule.
sasha (runtime): quick workaround: set `REDWOOD_USE_FALLBACK_KERNELS=true` and restart runtime pods; fallback disables fused CUDA kernels and uses safe aten kernels. I can push a canary config to the deployment.
jia (eng-sre): node had a GPU ECC error in dmesg earlier: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.` maybe driver/hardware.
devon (oncall): scaling replicas from 30->10 to reduce scheduling load and avoid thrashing. `kubectl scale deploy/inference-engine-rt --replicas=10`
marie (support): Can we notify impacted customers? AcmePay flagged 3 failures. ETA for rollback?
sasha (runtime): pushing rollout patch now with env var and image with extra guard. configmap change: ```yaml
env:
  - name: REDWOOD_USE_FALLBACK_KERNELS
n    value: "true"
```
ops-bot: RollingUpdate started for deployment/inference-engine-rt (strategy: RollingUpdate, maxUnavailable=20%)
devon (oncall): core dumps are being collected to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1735009999/ — grabper attached. Asking infra to isolate node for hardware triage.
jia (eng-sre): marking node as unschedulable and raising ticket with cloud provider. Node has repeated GPU resets, suggest replacement.
marie (support): emailed AcmePay with interim workaround (retry) and status. They're asking for SLA credit possibility — putting in escalation.
sasha (runtime): canary pods started with fallback kernel flag, initial logs show no segfaults. small perf hit but stable. sample log: ```
2026-01-12T03:25:14Z INFO runtime: fallback kernels enabled, using aten kernels for attention
2026-01-12T03:25:17Z INFO runtime: model load complete, accept traffic
```
devon (oncall): traffic rerouted, ingress reports 95% of traffic healthy now. continuing to monitor.
jia (eng-sre): alert silence for this incident, notify on-call next if reoccurs. adding annotation to cluster.
marie (support): updating customers: AcmePay ops notified, mitigation in place, perf impact ~ +20% latency for heavy prompts. ticket updated.
sasha (runtime): follow-up actions: - revert fused kernels to mainline after kernel patch & more testing - add sentinel in runtime to avoid calling fused kernel when ECC reset seen - add extra guard/uptime metrics for kernel crashes
devon (oncall): handing off to next oncall (sasha for runtime patching) for next 8 hours. I'm going offline after 30m. set incident severity to P2 -> monitoring mode.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=P2, owner=sasha (runtime), runbook=https://internal/redwood/runbooks/runtime-segfaults
sasha (runtime): capturing RCA notes here: likely combination of driver-level GPU reset causing memory corruption, fused CUDA kernels hit bad path -> segfault. need longer postmortem.
jia (eng-sre): collecting metrics: GPU memory histograms, pod restart counts, node Xid events. will attach to postmortem.
marie (support): will compile customer-impact summary and send to account team.
devon (oncall): thanks all. appreciate quick response. :heart:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: schedule hardware replacement for ip-10-0-23-17 on 2026-01-13 02:00 UTC
sasha (runtime): taking ownership of RCA and patch rollout. will coordinate with qa for regression tests. leaving notes in incident tracker.
marie (support): closing loop with customers, creating follow-up tickets for SLA discussion.
incident-bot: Thread archived to incident-1735009999 (mitigated)
